info.name: Azure Log Analytics Ingestion Tables API

description.content:
The Logs Ingestion API in Azure Monitor lets you send data to a Log Analytics workspace using REST API calls or client libraries. Send data to supported Azure tables or custom tables using data collection rules (DCR) for transformation and routing.
